member.name: T:VL.Stride.BepuPhysics.BodyNode
member.summary: A dynamic or kinematic rigid body simulated by BepuPhysics. Connect the output to an Entity (like a ModelComponent); the body drives the entity's transform. The entity's transform at attach time defines the initial pose. Connect one or more collider shapes; each shape instance can only be used by one body.

member.param: Collision shapes forming this body (combined into one rigid compound). Each shape instance can only be used by one body.
When true the body is unaffected by forces and collisions but pushes dynamic bodies away; move it via SetTargetPose or TeleportTo.
Smooths the rendered motion between fixed physics steps. Null = Interpolated (recommended for display-rate rendering).
The collision layer of this body (0..31); pair filtering is configured via the SimulationSettings collision matrix. Null = Layer0.
Contact spring stiffness in Hz — how hard contacts push overlapping bodies apart.
Contact spring damping; 1 = critical damping, higher values settle contacts more stiffly.
Surface friction; 0 = frictionless, 1 = rough. Combined with the other collidable's coefficient on contact.
Upper limit for the velocity used to push overlapping bodies apart; lower values soften deep-contact pops.
Velocity below which the body becomes a sleep candidate; -1 disables sleeping.
Whether gravity affects this body. Only evaluated when UsePerBodyAttributes is enabled on the simulation.
Continuous collision detection mode. Null = Discrete; use Continuous for fast bodies that would tunnel through thin geometry.
Connect a ContactEvents node's output here to receive contact begin/touch/end events for this body.
Places the body at this pose whenever the value CHANGES (a constant matrix = initial pose only). Do not wire a transformation into the entity instead.
While true, re-teleports the body to the TeleportTo pose and zeroes its velocities. Connect a Bang.
While true, writes all input values to the component again, overriding values written by setter nodes. Connect a Bang.
Advanced: use a MeshCollider or EmptyCollider instead of the Colliders shapes.
member.returns: The body component — connect to an Entity's Components input.
